tasks.brief: Create src/services/models.py: Implement module-level constants NEMOTRON_BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:8000', NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT = NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + '/v1/chat/completions', NEMOTRON_READY_URL = NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + '/v1/models', NEMOTRON_SCRIPT_PATH = '~/nemotron-vmlx.py' (expand via os.path.expanduser at call time), NEMOTRON_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30, NEMOTRON_TERMINATE_GRACE_SECONDS = 5. Track _nemotron_process (None when not loaded). Import subprocess and httpx at module level (not aliased, not wrapped) for test monkeypatching. Implement list_models() -> list[dict]: read LLM_ENDPOINT from os.environ, derive LM Studio base by stripping /chat/completions suffix, call httpx.get(base + '/v1/models'), on exception/non-2xx treat LM Studio portion as empty, append {'id': 'nemotron', 'source': 'nemotron'} iff is_nemotron_loaded() returns true. Implement is_nemotron_loaded() -> bool: return _nemotron_process is not None and poll() reports still-running. Implement load_nemotron() -> dict: idempotent if loaded; else spawn via subprocess.Popen(['python3', expanded_script_path]), store in _nemotron_process, poll NEMOTRON_READY_URL up to timeout; on success return {'status': 'loaded'}, on timeout terminate and return {'status': 'error', 'message': ...}. Implement unload_nemotron() -> dict: idempotent if not loaded; else terminate, wait up to grace seconds, escalate to kill(), clear _nemotron_process, return {'status': 'unloaded'}. Acceptance: tests/test_models_service.py::test_list_models_includes_lmstudio_entries, tests/test_models_service.py::test_list_models_returns_empty_on_exception, tests/test_models_service.py::test_list_models_returns_empty_on_non_2xx, tests/test_models_service.py::test_list_models_omits_nemotron_when_not_loaded, tests/test_models_service.py::test_list_models_includes_nemotron_when_loaded, tests/test_models_service.py::test_load_nemotron_spawns_and_confirms_ready, tests/test_models_service.py::test_load_nemotron_idempotent_when_already_loaded, tests/test_models_service.py::test_load_nemotron_timeout_clears_process_and_errors, tests/test_models_service.py::test_load_nemotron_expands_script_path, tests/test_models_service.py::test_unload_nemotron_terminates_process, tests/test_models_service.py::test_unload_nemotron_idempotent_when_not_loaded, tests/test_models_service.py::test_is_nemotron_loaded_true_when_process_running, tests/test_models_service.py::test_is_nemotron_loaded_false_when_no_process.

Create src/api/models.py: Implement FastAPI router with GET /api/v1/models, POST /api/v1/nemotron/load, POST /api/v1/nemotron/unload. GET /api/v1/models: call models.list_models() and return ModelsListResponse with 200. POST /api/v1/nemotron/load: call models.load_nemotron() and return NemotronLoadResponse with 200. POST /api/v1/nemotron/unload: call models.unload_nemotron() and return NemotronUnloadResponse with 200.
